text: The cream spun out of the milk is far richer than any grade sold, so the dairy blends it back with skimmed milk until the fat hits the legal figure, then heats it. Grades differ by country and by use: coffee, whipping, double. Cream is heated like milk, but because fat shields bacteria it is held a little hotter once it reaches 10 % fat. Equivalent time-temperature pairs are allowed; the figures are the US legal definitions (21 CFR 131.3).

steps.note: The cream undergoes heat treatment to kill harmful bacteria like Listeria, Salmonella and E. coli; cream from 10 % fat up is held a little hotter, as its fat shields the bacteria.
